verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships official SDKs across multiple languages (JS/TS, Python, Go, Java) with documented APIs, wrappers (wrap_openai), auto-instrumentation, and eval-building helpers, backed by GitHub SDK code examples and an API reference. There's a slight community note that documentation/integrations felt sparse in an early-stage review, but strong first-party docs and working code samples corroborate solid SDK support. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation beyond GitHub snippets and one mixed community review.
